rules.statement: With PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV=1, the smallest legal divider, SCLK must be f(i_clk)/2 and operate correctly in all four SPI modes.
With PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV=255, the largest legal divider, the half-period counter must work at full width and operate correctly in all four SPI modes with short bursts.

rules.condition: for each configuration CFG-BASE, CFG-MIN, CFG-MAX
rules.statement: Verification must run every listed configuration, and since SPI mode is a run-time input, each configuration must be exercised in all four SPI modes.
